description: This file sets up and manages a service worker for prefetching in a Qwik-based web application. It imports the setup function from Qwik's service worker module, calls it to initialize the service worker, and adds event listeners for 'install' and 'activate' events to control the service worker's lifecycle.

methods.name: setupServiceWorker
methods.description: Initializes and registers the service worker functionality for prefetching and other enhancements in the Qwik framework.
